about_the_game: Who thought staying alive on night shift at a roadside diner would be so hard? You thought you were living the dream, working a minimum wage job with your vampire bestfriend Vamp, but suddenly people all around you start dropping like flies. A mysterious fog traps everyone inside, and they tell tales of townsfolk meeting their fates at the hands of a vampire hiding somewhere in the shadows. Is your friendship strong enough to solve this mystery?

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoonish Murder Mystery Game, Involves Death, But Not Overly Graphic or Grotusque.
